content: Comparison: audit-ci and better-npm-audit both wrap npm's own advisory DB only (npm audit under the hood) and add allowlisting; OSV-Scanner (Google) queries a federated DB (OSV.dev + GHSA + NVD) giving broader coverage from one scan, is actively developed (SCA+secrets+IaC), and has low false positives. For CI gating strategy, PR-diff gating (fail only on newly introduced vulns) is the recommended pattern over failing on the full accumulated set.
